request_get_models: make a GET request to the LiteLLM proxy to list available models
request_post_chat_completions: make a POST request to send chat completion messages with JSON body to the proxy
request_get_health: make a GET request to check the proxy health status with custom headers
request_delete_resource: make a DELETE request to remove a resource on the proxy server
request_put_update_config: make a PUT request to update proxy configuration with JSON data and custom headers
